plan:
## Pitch

**Puppet maker: Strings.** Watch first. I have two curves running side by side, both 180 ms: ease-out and linear. Each file hangs on a string under the stage track, and when it is placed the string goes slack and the file drops onto the canvas. The frame breaks because the panel leaks into the editor. Components: string stage track, file marionettes, cancel-cuts-strings, canvas landing tray, completion summary, easing preview.

**Control room operator: Console import.** It has to last ten years and work with the mouse unplugged. The set is a stage list, a Cancel at thumb height with Escape as its twin, a per-file manifest you arrow through, retry for one failed file, a summary, and a shortcut sheet. Nothing reacts to hover, so nothing depends on it.

**Foley artist: Quiet manifest.** Show me the frame at rest first. A grey screen still says which stage is live: filled square, hollow square, tick. The set is an empty drop zone, a stage track, a manifest with shape glyphs, skip reasons, a completion summary, and a density toggle. It should be beautiful because it is legible.

**Velvet beetle: Found it.** I come back after lunch and three of my layers were swapped. The pack should answer one question: what changed, and can I get it back? The set is an empty drop zone, a stage track, cancel, a completion summary, undo import that names what returned, and a replaced-layer diff. Ctrl+Z works the way it always has.

## Clash

**Puppet maker:** Sample's running. Same 180 ms, linear against ease-out on the stage tick. Linear reads as a counter. Ease-out lands. I still want placed files to drop out of the panel onto the canvas.

**Control room operator:** The drop I can live with. Cancel can't be a corner icon that shows on hover. 44 px, bottom of the panel, Escape does the same. Tab order goes stages, Cancel, list.

**Foley artist:** Resting frame before motion. Take the colour away: which stage is active? Filled glyph, hollow glyph, tick, and the stage word in bold. After that it can be beautiful.

**Velvet beetle:** I'm the one who finds this later. Undo should say the names: logo-mark, hero-photo, headline. And Ctrl+Z, same as always. Nobody needs a new gesture.

**Control room operator:** Then Cancel and Undo overlap. Two reverse buttons in one panel.

**Velvet beetle:** No. Cancel stops work in flight. Undo reverses a finished change. Different moment, different word. On press it sinks 1 px and the shadow shrinks.

**Puppet maker:** Then the strings go. My break-out moves to the landing: placed files settle into the canvas tray once, then stop. The ease-out curve stays.

**Foley artist:** And the empty state gets one action. "Choose files." No docs link beside it.

## Decision

The team builds an import panel for a canvas editor, and a visitor can bring 14 files into a poster, see each named stage with real counts, cancel at any point, read a clear completion summary, and undo the import with the replaced layers named.

Concept: Brand kit import

**Contributions.** Puppet maker set the motion. The stage tick and the tray settle use a 180 ms ease-out, chosen over linear in a side-by-side sample, and play once. Control room operator set the input rules: no hover dependence, 44 px targets, Escape for Cancel, Ctrl+Z for Undo, and a fixed tab order. Foley artist set the state language: filled, hollow and ticked glyphs plus bold text, so no state relies on colour, and the empty drop zone has a single action. Velvet beetle made the case for undo naming what came back and for a quiet 1 px pressed depth. The beetle also defended Ctrl+Z.

**Rejected direction.** Strings was rejected. The marionette drop was mostly art and gave the visitor no new information. It also repeated the 2026-10-23 file-drop-in-a-well falling motion. Its easing study survived.

**Source.** https://github.com/isas1/creative-sites-vault/blob/1595af38a69fbb67c674ef4b90b776a2245c270b/00-components/loaders/05-dash-orbital-ring/var-1-arc-spinner.html. One mechanism is kept: a bordered ring with one coloured top edge, rotated by a CSS keyframe at 0.8 s linear. It is used only in row 2, at 14 px, on the active stage. Improvements:

1. The spinner's generic "Loading" label is replaced with stage text and real file counts in a polite live region.
2. Under reduced motion the ring is a static arc with the word "running". The source only removed the animation.
3. The arc is removed on complete, cancelled and failed, and an explicit glyph and summary take its place.

The shadow DOM, the badge and the housing card are dropped, and the shared tokens apply.

**Why 6.** Each row answers a different visitor moment:

- Nothing chosen yet (empty drop zone).
- What is happening now (stage track).
- How to stop it (Cancel import).
- Which files did what (manifest).
- How it ended (completion summary).
- How to take it back (Undo import).

A retry-one-file row and a shortcut sheet were cut. Retry overlaps the 2026-10-27 pipeline retry. The shortcuts fit in each row's input text.

## Build notes

1. Reserve label widths with `min-width` in `ch` for the longest label. That is "Cancel import" in row 3 and "Redo import" in row 6. Label swaps then cause no layout shift at 320 px.
2. Throttle the row 2 live region to stage changes and every fifth file. Thirteen convert ticks would otherwise flood a screen reader.
3. The row 6 history entry must hold layer snapshots, not references. If the visitor edits a replacing layer and then undoes, the original hero-photo must come back. Test this by editing a replacing layer, undoing, and checking the restored layer.

components.name: File manifest
components.description: Per-file list showing each file's state with shape glyphs and a short reason.
components.purpose: Show what happened to each file.
components.use: A designer finds that ad-banner.psd was skipped as an unsupported type.
components.input: Click or tap a row to expand its reason. Keyboard: Tab into the list, Up and Down move between rows, Home and End jump, Enter expands.
components.outcome: The expanded row shows type, size and reason ('Unsupported type .psd', 'Replaces layer hero-photo').
components.recovery: Collapsing a row with Enter or a second tap returns it to one line. Selection persists across stage updates.
components.mechanism: A listbox with roving tabindex. Rows update in place by file id, so the order never jumps. Glyphs are a hollow circle (queued), a filled circle (placed), a slashed circle (skipped) and a double ring (replaced), each paired with a word.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-10-26 log viewer event list. That list filters past events. This one updates live per file and carries outcome reasons.
components.usefulness: A summary count alone hides which file failed and why.
components.creativeDifference: Each state has its own shape and word, so the list reads in greyscale.
states: queued: hollow glyph, reached on read
working: bold row text, reached when the file's stage runs
placed: filled glyph
replaced: double ring with the layer name
skipped: slashed glyph with reason
expanded: detail line, reached by Enter or tap
focus: row ring, reached by arrows

components.name: Import summary
components.description: Completion card with grouped counts, skip reasons and one next action.
components.purpose: End the import with a clear statement of what landed.
components.use: A designer reads 'Imported 12 of 14 · 3 replaced · 2 skipped · 14:52'.
components.input: Click or tap Show skipped to jump to the manifest rows. Keyboard: Tab to the link and press Enter. Focus moves to the summary heading on completion.
components.outcome: The counts are grouped by placed, replaced and skipped. The placed files settle into the canvas tray once at 180ms ease-out.
components.recovery: If nothing was placed, the card reads 'Nothing imported' and offers a single 'Choose other files' action.
components.mechanism: The summary is rendered once from the final job record. Focus moves to an h2 with tabindex=-1. The tray settle is one transform transition and is skipped under reduced motion.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-10-28 load stages completion line. That was one line. This row groups outcomes and links to the skipped files.
components.usefulness: It gives the visitor a definite end, with no ambiguity between done and stuck.
components.creativeDifference: The landing motion carries the Puppet maker's frame break into the editor once, then stops.
states: complete: all files placed
complete-with-skips: counts plus a Show skipped link
nothing-imported: one action 'Choose other files'
undone: struck summary with 'Undone at 14:53', reached by row 6
reduced-motion: no tray settle

components.name: Undo import
components.description: Undo button that reverses a finished import and names the layers that came back.
components.purpose: Reverse a completed import and show what was restored.
components.use: A designer undoes the import and reads 'Restored logo-mark, hero-photo, headline · removed 12'.
components.input: Click or tap Undo import. Keyboard: Tab to it and press Enter or Space, or press Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on macOS) while the editor has focus.
components.outcome: Imported layers are removed and the 3 replaced layers return in their original order. The restored names are listed and briefly outlined on the canvas.
components.recovery: Redo import (Ctrl+Shift+Z) reapplies the same import. A second undo with an empty history does nothing and reads 'Nothing to undo'.
components.mechanism: One history entry per import stores the removed layer snapshots and the added layer ids. Undo swaps them as one operation. The label swaps within a reserved width: Undo import, Undone, Redo import.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-10-20 undo in rewind, which animated a mistake playing backward. This undo is instant and names what returned.
components.usefulness: An import that silently replaces layers needs a way back that says what it restored.
components.creativeDifference: The result is a named list of what came back. Restoration is reported, not implied.
states: available: enabled after complete
pressed: 1px sink with a reduced shadow
undone: restored names listed and the label set to 'Redo import'
redone: summary returns to complete
empty-history: disabled with 'Nothing to undo'
focus: 2px ring

demo.sharedState: One job record and one canvas model for Spring poster.canvas (9 layers). Row 1 starts the job with sample brand-kit.zip (14 files). Row 2 and row 4 read the job's stage index and per-file states. Row 3 aborts the job and rolls back the placed list. On completion, row 5 renders the final record and row 6 receives one history entry: 12 added ids and 3 replaced snapshots. Undo updates the canvas, the row 5 summary and the row 4 glyphs together. A demo toggle forces a failure at Convert.
